How it works. The expanded uncertainty U (above) shows how accurately the ABSOLUTE dose is known (calibration ND,w, kQ, etc.). It is not a tolerance for the drift of the accelerator. The drift is assessed relative to your own baseline (the nominal value): the constant components of the uncertainty cancel in the comparison, and the random part remains (σ of Type A). Therefore the decision is made by the tolerance ±T, while U_rel (below) is needed to tell whether the measured deviation differs from noise. The tolerance T is set by your quality control programme.
